goal: Adopt part B of the nvk/llm-wiki benchmark: a volatility field with migration, a human-gated wiki-refresh skill for living web sources, a source-retraction mode in wiki-delete with marker tracking, and a golden/defect fixture test suite for lint_wiki.py wired into CI.

tasks.title: Add volatility field: rules, lint, template, migration
tasks.acceptance: volatility is documented in wiki-content.md section 1 as REQUIRED on wiki/sources/* with enum hot|warm|cold (fixed snapshots such as YouTube talks = cold; living official documentation = hot or warm), enforced by lint_wiki.py (exit 1 on missing/invalid), present in the source-page template, and assigned on all 27 existing source pages (frontmatter-only edit, no updated bump). python3 scripts/lint_wiki.py exits 0.

tasks.title: Create wiki-refresh skill
tasks.acceptance: The skill selects hot/warm sources, re-fetches their URLs, diffs against the stored raw/ capture, classifies each change as cosmetic, additive, or contradictory, and presents the assessment for human confirmation BEFORE touching any wiki page. It never edits raw/ files: a materially changed source is saved as a new raw file with the source page recording refresh history; contradictions follow the existing keep-both-and-flag principle. CLAUDE.md section 3 routes 최신화/refresh phrasing to the skill; wiki-content.md documents the workflow.

tasks.title: Add retract mode to wiki-delete and marker check to lint
tasks.acceptance: wiki-delete SKILL.md offers source retraction alongside the existing three scopes: map blast radius with lint_wiki.py --inbound, flag claims citing the retracted source with <!--RETRACTED-SOURCE--> markers, re-synthesize affected paragraphs from remaining sources, then remove markers; the raw file and source page are deleted only with explicit user confirmation (raw/ deletion stays opt-in per the existing rule). lint_wiki.py gains a check that reports any remaining <!--RETRACTED-SOURCE--> marker as a violation (exit 1).

tasks.title: Build golden and defect fixtures with a stdlib test runner
tasks.acceptance: tests/fixtures/golden-wiki/ is a minimal known-good wiki (about 2 sources + 1 concept + 1 entity + index.md + matching raw/ stubs) on which lint_wiki.py exits 0. tests/fixtures/defects/ holds one broken variant per lint check (including the new credibility, volatility, and retraction-marker checks), each failing lint with the intended violation. scripts/test_lint_wiki.py is a stdlib assert-based runner (no framework) that runs lint against golden expecting exit 0 and against each defect expecting exit 1 plus the right violation substring, and itself exits nonzero on any mismatch.

tasks.title: Wire the lint test runner into CI
tasks.acceptance: The existing lint job runs python3 scripts/test_lint_wiki.py after lint_wiki.py, and the workflow paths trigger includes tests/. The verify matrix jobs are unchanged.

tasks.title: Dry-run refresh and retract, then phase gate
tasks.scope: dry-runs (no permanent wiki mutation), log.md (append), docs/index.md, docs/rules/site-code.md (accumulated rules)
tasks.acceptance: wiki-refresh dry-run against the Terraform docs source reaches the human-confirmation step with a coherent change classification and is aborted without edits; retract dry-run executes end-to-end on a COPY of the golden fixture (never the real wiki). The lint-rules-are-the-schema principle is recorded in site-code.md accumulated rules. Repo lint and test runner exit 0, CI is green on push, and one Korean docs-prefixed close-out line is appended to log.md with the docs/index.md phase row updated.
